title: CWP/13322/2024 of KULDEEP CHAND Vs PUNJAB STATE CIVIL SUPPLIES CORPORATION LIMITED(PUNSUP)
respondents: Punjab State Civil Supplies Corporation Limited(Punsup)
text:
CWP-13322 of 2024 (O&M) 1 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 246/2 CWP-13322 of 2024 (O&M) Date of Decision:28.05.2025 Kuldeep Chand ....Petitioner Versus Punjab State Civil Supplies Corporation Limited (PUNSUP) .....Respondent CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA Present: Mr. Padamkant Dwivedi, Advocate, for the petitioner. Mr. Ranjit Singh Kalra, Advocate, for the respondent. DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA, J. (Oral)

1. In the present writ petition, the petitioner is praying for quashing of order dated 29.08.2023 (Annexure P-2) whereby, a fact finding enquiry for ascertaining the role of the petitioner has been ordered.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the issue involved in the present writ petition is duly covered by the judgment passed by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court in case titled as Punjab State Warehousing Corporation Field Employees Union versus Union of India and others, CWP No.27725 of 2013 and other connected petitions, decided on 14.05.2025. However, he submits that a perusal of the aforesaid order CWP-13322 of 2024 (O&M) 2 would reflect that the liberty has been granted to the petitioners therein, to submit the representation, which will be considered by the concerned authority in terms of the order passed by the Court. He further submits that the present petition may be treated as a representation and the respondent be directed to consider the same in light of the order passed in CWP No.27725 of 2013 and other connected petitions, decided on 14.05.2025.

3. In view of the above, the present writ petition is disposed of in terms of the judgment passed in CWP-27725 of 2013 and other connected petitions, decided on 14.05.2025.

4. The respondent is directed to treat the present writ petition as a representation and take a decision in terms of the judgment passed by a coordinate Bench of this Court in CWP-27725 of 2013 and other connected petitions, decided on 14.05.2025

5. Pending application(s), if any, also stand(s) disposed of. (DEEPINDER SINGH NALWA) JUDGE May 28, 2025 dinesh
